Several weeks (6 access parts scattered across the map + 5 bosses in the library, each with a 20 h cooldown)

{npc:Dedoras}, in south-east Cormaya, is searching for Zathroth's secret library before the servants of {wiki:Variphor} steal the knowledge about the Godbreaker. You gather six clues scattered around the world (a lost island, the {wiki:Deep Desert}, the {wiki:Deathlings}, the basement of the {wiki:Asura Palace}, the Order of the Falcon and the Thais museum extension), receive the {wiki:Battle Mage Outfits|Battle Mage Outfit} and enter the {wiki:Secret Library} via the Isle of the Kings to face four bosses and, at the end, {creature:The Scourge of Oblivion}. The quest unlocks several high-level hunting places.
Stop Variphor's servants from stealing the knowledge of how to use the Godbreaker from Zathroth's Secret Library.
Minimum level **250** (it is also the level needed to enter the {wiki:Falcon Bastion} and the Asura Palace basement). For the Secret Library bosses, level **500+** is recommended.
First mission of the {wiki:Liquid Black Quest} completed (*The First Visitor*), for the *Liquid Death* part.
{wiki:Asura Palace Quest} and {wiki:The Lost Brother Quest} completed, for the *The Lament* part.
{wiki:The New Frontier Quest} completed — only needed to use the shortcut boat between the {wiki:Zao Steppe} and the {wiki:Falcon Bastion}.

Access to the {wiki:Isle of the Kings}: become a friend of {npc:Dalbrect} by giving him the {item:Family Brooch} (first part of {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest}). To return on {npc:Captain Jack}'s boat, {npc:Costello} must have given you permission.
Team: the {creature:Furious Scorpion} is **solo**; {creature:Brokul} and each of the 4 library bosses allow up to **5 players**; the final battle allows up to **10**.
to fill with chalk at the Falcon Outpost
Two more {wiki:Containers|liquid containers}, one with {wiki:Blood|blood} and the other with {wiki:Water|water} (Order of the Falcon ritual)
3 different foods (for example {item:Ham}, {item:Meat}, {item:Apple|Apples} or {item:Brown Mushroom|Brown Mushrooms}) for the Deep Desert statues
or another red non-metal armour, such as the {item:Firemind Raiment} (The Diamond Blossom)
or a Secret Service tool, to mine the Extension Site crystals
to enter the Secret Library (the Secret Agent Tool won't do)
or {item:Helmet of the Deep}, for Ghulosh
to heal The Book of Secrets in the final battle
recommended: the wiki doesn't describe the way out of several areas of this quest (Deep Desert, Sunken Temple, Ancient Ancestorial Grounds, Falcon Bastion, Secret Library)

Access to the {wiki:Falcon Bastion}, the {wiki:Deep Desert} (Elite Skeletons), the {wiki:Ancient Ancestorial Grounds} (Deathlings), {wiki:The Extension Site} (Thais museum), the {wiki:Asura Palace} basement and the {wiki:Secret Library}
every team member receives it when killing Brokul
{wiki:Battle Mage Outfits|Battle Mage Outfit} (base), given by {npc:Dedoras}
Part *The Order of the Falcon*: ritual of blood, water and chalk at the {wiki:Falcon Outpost}, in Edron.
Shortcut boat Zao Steppe ↔ Falcon Bastion
By using one of the ends of the small boat south of the swimming area, next to the castle.
Only with {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} completed. On the Zao side, the boat is north-east of the Zao Steppe ({coord:33326,31351,7}).
After the castle's four minibosses and the {creature:Dazed Leaf Golem}.
Part *The Path of Defiances* (all areas of the building).
Part *Liquid Death*: new passage from the Deepling Ancestorial Grounds.
After repairing 9 {item:Broken Idol|Broken Idols} in the Ancient Ancestorial Grounds.
Part *The Lament*, through the {item:Wall Mirror (Quest)} on the palace's ground floor.
Part *MoTA Bursting at the Seams*: {npc:Gareth} opens the sealed door for you ({key:extension}, {key:problem}, {key:yes}).
When you hand the six clues to {npc:Dedoras} ({key:check}).
With the base outfit, {npc:Dedoras} gives you the addons in exchange for {item:Sturdy Book|Sturdy Books} and {item:Epaulette|Epaulettes}.
After the {key:check} with {npc:Dedoras}: use a {item:Scythe} on the {item:Monument} on the Isle of the Kings.
Secret Library bosses (Lokathmor, Mazzinor, Ghulosh, Gorzindel and The Scourge of Oblivion)
Inside the library; the final battle only opens after you kill the other four.
Requires the Order of the Falcon access (done in this quest), in addition to the Order of the Cobra access from the {wiki:Grave Danger Quest}.

The wiki spoiler presents the six access parts in the order of this guide. The wiki explicitly says that the *Order of the Falcon* can be started without having done the others, but only **at night** (between 18:00 and 06:00 Tibia time; in real time, between minute :45 of one hour and minute :15 of the next).
Keep the 9 *The Grand Master of Verbal Debate* documents you find in the Falcon Bastion: they are the cheat sheet for {creature:Grand Master Oberon} (the answers are also in section 7 of this guide).
Grand Master Oberon, Brokul and all the Secret Library bosses have a **20 h** cooldown. The {creature:Furious Scorpion} can be repeated **every 2 hours**.
Keep the {item:Bone Fiddle}: it is one of the quest rewards.
Everything starts and ends with Dedoras. He needs six pieces of information to find the entrance to Zathroth's secret library.

{npc:Dedoras} is not in Edron city but in the **south-east** of the island of {wiki:Cormaya}, south of Edron. At Edron's **north** harbour, talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp). You land at Cormaya's **north** harbour, next to {npc:Pemaret}; from there walk **south-east** to Dedoras.
You can also reach Cormaya by {wiki:Steamship} from Kazordoon or Farmine (you land next to {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below the island).

Say {key:hi} and {key:search}. Dedoras explains that he needs more information and gives you six clues. You can ask about each one ({key:museum}, {key:desert}, {key:fishmen}, {key:order}, {key:asuri}, {key:isle}) to hear what he knows. The table shows which part of the guide matches each clue.
Secret island west of Meluna ({npc:Charles}'s shortcut, Port Hope)
To return to Edron, go back to Cormaya's **north** harbour and talk to {npc:Pemaret}: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (20 gp). From Edron you can take a boat to any other city.
2. High and Dry — the lost island (Port Hope)
The document for this part is on a secret island you can only reach by getting shipwrecked on Captain Charles's shortcut.

Take a boat to **Port Hope** (say {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to your city's captain; from Edron it is {npc:Captain Seahorse}). You arrive at {npc:Charles}'s boat, at the far **west** of Port Hope.

Talk to {npc:Charles}: {key:hi}, {key:shortcut}, {key:yes} and choose a destination: {key:thais} (100 gp), {key:edron} (90 gp), {key:liberty bay} (20 gp) or {key:yalahar} (200 gp). The **first time** you use the shortcut you always get shipwrecked on the right island, **west of Meluna**.

If you have already been on the island and didn't get the {item:Sealed Scroll}, you can go back, but from the second time on you don't always get shipwrecked, and when you do you can end up on one of **4 different islands**. You can only get shipwrecked with Charles's shortcut **once a day**.
On the island, go **north-west**, go down the stairs and take the {item:Sealed Scroll} from the {item:Brass-Shod Chest}. Now you have to find a way off the island.
The chest with the Sealed Scroll
Use the {item:Heap of Rubbish} to the **south** to receive a {item:Hawser (Item)|Hawser}.
1. The Heap of Rubbish with the Hawser
Use the {item:Hawser (Item)|Hawser} on the **south-east** corner of the raft (Raft), which is broken.
Look through the telescope at night

Go back to the **south** coast and use the {item:Ship's Telescope} to get your navigation bearings. It has to be **at night** ({wiki:Night|Night}: between 18:00 and 06:00 Tibia time; in real time, between minute :45 of one hour and minute :15 of the next); during the day you get *“The telescope provides a perfect view over the endless ocean - no land in sight.”* You can move on when you see *“By using the telescope you observate the stellar constellations. This should help you to navigate your way back to mainland.”* or *“You already have all information you need from observing the stellar constellations.”*
3. The Ship's Telescope (use it at night)
Leave the island on the raft

Go to the raft and step onto it: you sail back to **Fibula** and see *“The raft was not that solid in the end, its parts are floating in the ocean now. But at least you reached dry land.”* From Fibula walk **north-east** through the {wiki:Fibula Tunnel} to **Thais**.
High and Dry part completed (keep the Sealed Scroll)
Beneath the desert west of Darashia there is a building with four puzzles. Each one gives you a ritual object; with all four you open the way to a solo fight against the Furious Scorpion.

Travel to **Darashia**: by boat (say {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes} to your city's captain; you arrive at {npc:Petros}'s harbour) or by magic carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}). Leave the city to the **west** through the desert to the {item:Vortex (Green)|sand vortex} and step into it: you appear in the {wiki:Deep Desert}.
Bring a {item:Rope}: you'll go down a hole and will have to climb back up through it.
Go down to the puzzle floor
Leave the building on the **south** side, go around it on the **west** side and go down the hole at this spot.
You'll have to fight many {creature:Skeleton Elite Warrior|Skeleton Elite Warriors} and {creature:Undead Elite Gladiator|Undead Elite Gladiators}, which are very strong.

Starting on the carpet, follow an **invisible path** around the room to the quest door (follow the image). If you step on a wrong square, red music notes appear on your character and you have to start again from the carpet.
The invisible path to the quest door
After going through the door, take the {item:Ritual Stone Tablet} from the {item:Brass-Shod Chest} to the **north** of the room.

From the first chest, leave through the sand corridor to the **east** and follow it. This puzzle is simply about forcing your way through the horde of {creature:Skeleton Elite Warrior|Skeleton Elite Warriors} and {creature:Undead Elite Gladiator|Undead Elite Gladiators} in this narrow corridor. Once you've gone all the way round you are back inside the building and receive a Quest Log update.

Take the {item:Exultant Ritual Figurine} from the chest there. Then go back through the {item:Door (Sealed)|sealed door} just to the **south** and continue **south-west**, where you find another sealed door.

Go through the quest door, go around the building on the **west** side and go down the stairs to the **north**. Here you have to step on the coloured carpets the right number of times and in the right order (it is shown just north of the lava pool). When you get it right, *“Access Granted!”* appears.
If you see this, you got it wrong: start again
If music notes appear on your character, you got it wrong: start again from the green carpet.
Step into the teleport to cross the lava and take the {item:Ritual Sword} from the chest.

From the lava room go **north**, continue **east** and then **south**. You reach a room with 4 bonelord statues; the **north** one has a glowing eye. Place a food item (for example {item:Ham}, {item:Meat}, {item:Apple} or {item:Brown Mushroom}) on each of the **three southern Stone Blocks**: the eye of the matching statue lights up.
Run to the sealed door to the **east**, where you find the {item:Ritual Figurine}.

With the four objects ({item:Ritual Stone Tablet}, {item:Exultant Ritual Figurine}, {item:Ritual Sword} and {item:Ritual Figurine}), go back to the entrance on the floor above and climb the long staircase to the **west**. Use each object on the matching Stone Socket. From then on you can go through the 4 doors just **east** of this room.

Behind the doors there is a teleport. When you step in you are taken to the **east** side of the room; when you move **west**, the {creature:Furious Scorpion}, 4 {creature:Skeleton Elite Warrior|Skeleton Elite Warriors} and 2 {creature:Undead Elite Gladiator|Undead Elite Gladiators} appear. Use {item:Energy Bomb Rune|Energy Bomb Runes} and {item:Poison Bomb Rune|Poison Bomb Runes} (or walls) to shield yourself from the creatures so you only take damage from the boss. You have **5 minutes** to kill it, open the chest in the room and leave through the **south teleport**; if time runs out, you are thrown out of the room.
Get ready for a very tough fight
It is a **solo** fight and **you can't leave without killing the boss**. The Furious Scorpion easily hits for over 1000 damage. You can repeat the fight every 2 hours.
Undead Elite Gladiators can walk through energy fields and Skeleton Elite Warriors walk through poison: place energy bombs, but make the **last** bomb a poison one.

After killing the boss and opening the chest, leave the room through the **south teleport**. The wiki doesn't say where that teleport leaves you, nor does it describe the way out of the Deep Desert to the surface: go back the way you came, climb up through the hole with the {item:Rope} and return to where you arrived when you stepped into the sand vortex. If you can't find the way out, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your temple (it doesn't work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block). Back in the desert, walk **east** to Darashia and take the boat ({npc:Petros}) or the carpet ({npc:Chemar}).
4. Liquid Death — the Deathlings (Banuta and Gray Beach)
Spectulus, in Edron, has already studied fish-like creatures. You discover the Deathlings' plans in a sunken temple and then help the Deeplings against them.
In **Edron**, go to the Ivory Towers ({wiki:Noodles Academy of Modern Magic}), in the **east** part of the city, and go up to {npc:Spectulus}. Say {key:hi}, {key:rumours} and {key:yes}.

Take a boat to **Port Hope** (from Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}). Cross the Tiquanda jungle **north-east** to {wiki:Banuta}. The {wiki:Deathlings}' {wiki:Sunken Temple} is **north** of Banuta: step into the {item:Water Vortex|water vortex} at this spot.
If you have the **Ranger** rank in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}, {npc:Lorek}, at the far **east** of Port Hope, takes you straight to Banuta.
After the vortex, go up the stairs and fight your way to the central room on the lower floor. In that room there are some {wiki:Twines|twines}.

Stand on the square **east** of the twines, face **west** and use {spell:Levitate} upwards ({key:exani hur up}). You reach a small room with a {item:Large Seashell Book}: when you look at it and learn about the Deathlings' plans, you receive a Quest Log update.

The wiki doesn't describe a dedicated exit from the Sunken Temple: go back the way you came in to where you arrived after the water vortex, north of Banuta. If you can't find the way out, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your temple (it doesn't work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block). Then cross the jungle **south-west** to Port Hope, where {npc:Charles} takes you by boat (for example to Edron: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}).
Go back to {npc:Spectulus}, in Edron, and talk to him about {key:rumours} and {key:Njey}.

Take the boat to **Gray Island** (150 gp): there are boats only from Ab'Dendriel, Darashia ({npc:Petros}), Edron and Venore ({key:hi}, {key:gray island}, {key:yes}). On the island, go into the hole **south** of {npc:Scrutinon}, head **north-east** on floor -1 and step into the {item:Water Vortex}. On the other side, use the {item:Rope} on the spot on the ground and go **north** to {wiki:Gray Beach}.
Go down to the Ancestorial Grounds

Go into the hole **east** of the beach and go down the ramps. Then follow the map to the Deepling Ancestorial Grounds. According to the wiki's description: go down several flights of stairs, then go up **two floors** to the **east** and you reach a teleport. That is where a new passage opens to the place where the Deathlings attack the Deeplings, the {wiki:Ancient Ancestorial Grounds}.
Teleport to the Ancient Ancestorial Grounds
Route from Gray Beach to the Ancestorial Grounds

Your task is to help the Deeplings: repair **9 {item:Broken Idol|Broken Idols}** scattered around the area (just use them). Follow the map to go around the **2 floors** repairing the idols; the images show where each one is.
Map of the Broken Idols on both floors
You don't have to face Brokul straight away. You can repair more idols, up to **45** in total: the more you repair, the less health Brokul has at the start of the fight.

With the 9 idols repaired you earn the right to face the Deathlings' boss, {creature:Brokul}, with a team of **up to 5 players**. The portal is on the far **west** side of this cave, going down at this spot. When the fight starts, several {creature:Neutral Deepling Warrior|Neutral Deepling Warriors} appear: they can attack you, but they also attack the boss (and are attacked by him), so it pays to keep them alive.
All team members receive {item:The True Book of Death}
Brokul can be repeated every 20 hours.

The wiki doesn't describe the way out of the Ancient Ancestorial Grounds or of Brokul's room: go back the same way to the teleport and the hole east of Gray Beach (climb up with the {item:Rope} where needed) and do the underground passage in reverse to Gray Island. If you can't find the way out, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your temple (it doesn't work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block). On Gray Island, {npc:Scrutinon} takes you **for free** to Ab'Dendriel, Darashia, Edron or Venore: say {key:hi}, {key:travel} and the name of the city (for example {key:edron}).
5. The Lament — the Asura Palace basement
You need The Lost Brother Quest and the Asura Palace Quest done. In the palace's secret basement you'll gather items, build an instrument and play the ballad that opens the last portal.

The {wiki:Asura Palace} is in {wiki:Tiquanda}, next to the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}, **north** of the merchant {npc:Tarun}. The simplest route is from **Ankrahmun**: leave the city to the **west**, climb the mountains, cross the bridge up there and go down to the ladder that takes you to the jungle side. You can also walk from **Port Hope**, heading **east** through the jungle.
Tarun (the palace is to the north)
Enter the basement through the mirror

On the palace ground floor, look for the {item:Wall Mirror (Quest)} and use it to enter the secret basement (it only lets in characters of level 250+). On this floor you have to collect several items by dropping through some cracks in the floor; the map shows where.
Map of the first basement floor
Walk to the far **east**, drop through some cracks and pick up the {item:Lotus Key}.
Go back the way you came, follow the corridor **south**, drop through the cracks and pick up the {item:Strand of Hair}.
Use the {item:Lotus Key} to open the door furthest **south** and head **east**. Drop through the cracks and pick up the {item:Eye Key}.
Go back out through the door, find the other door to the **east** and open it with the {item:Eye Key}.

Go down to the next floor. There is nothing to do here for now: walk to the far **south-west** and go down again. On this floor walk **north**, then keep going **east**, and step into the portal. Pick up the {item:Silver Chimes}. Then you can go back up.

On the second basement floor you'll collect more items and face True Asuri minibosses (map). So that the bosses aren't invincible, you have to use or equip the right item **before** entering the portal.
Map of the second basement floor

According to the wiki, at the moment you don't even need to kill the bosses (this may be a bug that gets fixed later): just pick up the {item:Piece of Ebony} in {creature:The Diamond Blossom}'s room and the {item:Skull (Quest)} in {creature:The Lily of Night}'s room, without killing them, so you don't need to make them vulnerable either.

Equip a **red non-metal** armour (for example a {item:Firemind Raiment} or a {item:Doublet}) and step into the portal to face {creature:The Diamond Blossom}. Take the {item:Piece of Ebony} from the chest.
Equip the {item:Silver Chimes} (as a shield) and step into the portal to face {creature:The Blazing Rose}. Don't forget to loot the {item:Perfume Flacon} she drops.

Go back to the third floor. Go to the {wiki:Death Portal} in the central room, use the {item:Perfume Flacon} and step in to face {creature:The Lily of Night}. Pick up the {item:Skull (Quest)} before leaving.
Map of the third basement floor
Go to the room to the **north** and take {item:The Peacock Ballad} from the chest.

To enter the final {wiki:Energy Portal} on floor -2 you have to play and sing the *Peacock Ballad*, so improvise an instrument: use the {item:Piece of Ebony} on the {item:Skull (Quest)} to get a {item:Bone Fiddle Without Strings}; then use the {item:Strand of Hair} on it to get the {item:Bone Fiddle}.
Play in front of the purple portal

Go to the purple portal on floor -2 and use the {item:Bone Fiddle} in front of it. Make sure you receive a Quest Log update; if you don't, it didn't work. Even so, you still can't get in: the ballad is cursed.
Without the Quest Log update you have to repeat this step.

The wiki doesn't describe the way out of the basement: go back up the way you came down to the palace ground floor (where the Wall Mirror is) and leave through the entrance. If you can't find the way out, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your temple (it doesn't work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block). Then cross the jungle **west** to Port Hope.
In **Port Hope**, look for {npc:Gail} above the depot (she is the missing girl's mother). Say {key:hi} and {key:daughter}: when you tell her her daughter's story, the curse is lifted.
Enter the portal and get the Secret Map

Go back to the Asura Palace and go down through the Wall Mirror again to the second basement floor. Play the {item:Bone Fiddle} in front of the portal again: now you can get in. Inside there are 5 True Asuri in the room, linked to Zathroth's plans. Walk past the {item:Writing Desk (Quest)|Writing Desk} to the **north** to receive a {item:Secret Map}. You can now report to {npc:Dedoras}.

Climb out of the basement the same way to the ground floor and leave the palace. If you can't find the way out, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your temple (it doesn't work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block). Head back **south** to {npc:Tarun} and from there follow the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass} to **Ankrahmun**, or go back through the jungle to Port Hope, where {npc:Charles} takes you by boat.
6. The Order of the Falcon — Falcon Outpost and Falcon Bastion

This part **can only be started at night** (between 18:00 and 06:00 Tibia time; in real time, between minute :45 of one hour and minute :15 of the next) and doesn't require the other parts. You need level 250, a Bucket and two containers with blood and water.
Go to the ramp north of Wyvern Mountain
In **Edron**, go up the ramp just **north** of Wyvern Mountain and cross the bridge to the **south**. You'll see a pile of chalk on the ground.
Start this part **at night** (between 18:00 and 06:00 Tibia time; in real time, between minute :45 of one hour and minute :15 of the next).
Use the {item:Bucket} on the chalk ({item:Chalk}) on the ground to get a {item:Bucket Filled with Chalk (Fine)}.
Go up to the Falcon Outpost
In the **south-east** corner, face **south** and use {spell:Levitate} upwards ({key:exani hur up}). Then go up the stairs to the {wiki:Falcon Outpost}.
Take the {item:Page from a Mystic Book} from the chest. It has the ritual instructions for entering the {wiki:Falcon Bastion}.

The symbol of the Order of the Falcon is painted on the floor, with a lit incense stick. Pour the first two ingredients on the **south-east** side of the symbol, on top of the incense, and the chalk on the **north-east** side (the top-right square of the symbol). When you use the chalk bucket you are teleported to the Falcon castle.
Use the {item:Bucket Filled with Chalk (Fine)} on the north-east square of the symbol
Use the chalk bucket on the marked square (top-right corner of the symbol)
The blood and water only need to be poured by **one** player; the rest of the team only uses the chalk.

In the castle there are several chests, corpses and pieces of furniture where you find valuable items, a {item:Can of Grease} (opens the lower gate), the {item:Key 0909} and **9 documents** about *The Grand Master of Verbal Debate* (keep them: they are the reference for the final boss). A {item:Key 0808} also appears (more than once a day). The Key 0909 opens these two ground-floor doors; the Can of Grease is at this spot on the ground floor and opens the gate marked in the coordinates.
Gate (opens with the Can of Grease)
Watch out for the cracks in the floor: if you step on them you fall to the floor below.

Your mission here is to kill **4 minibosses**, in this order, to gain access to certain quest doors; if you skip one, you can't enter the next area. Every team member must deal real damage to each miniboss: everyone has to see *“Your deeds have been noticed.”* in the Loot Channel. The minibosses spawn like normal creatures, roughly **every 5 minutes**: if you need to kill one again or someone killed it recently, wait.
Be especially careful when going up and down stairs: you can get surrounded by {creature:Falcon Knight|Falcon Knights} and {creature:Falcon Paladin|Falcon Paladins}.
Go up to the roof and go to the room to the **north-east** to face {creature:Grand Commander Soeren}.

From there, keep walking **south** and go down the stairs (not the ones you came up: the ones south of those). To the **east** you find {creature:Preceptor Lazare} in a small room **north** of the monks.
Go down two floors, go through the quest door and go to the big room to the **north** to face {creature:Grand Chaplain Gaunder}.
Go down to the ground floor and keep going **north** to a small boat. Use it to go to an island to the north, where {creature:Grand Canon Dominus} is.
Small boat to Grand Canon Dominus's island
With the four minibosses dead, you can enter the room that connects to the underground area of the Falcon Bastion.
Underground area; the star marks the energy portal
Activate the shortcut boat to Zao

When you reach the ground floor, leave the castle to the **north**, go around it on the **west** side and enter the swimming area. To the **south** of it there is a small boat (you can also get there by deliberately falling through the cracks at this spot, 2 floors above the ground floor, or by opening the castle door with the {item:Key 0909}). Use one of the ends of the boat to gain access to the shortcut. From then on you can come to the castle by the boat **north-east** of the {wiki:Zao Steppe}.
Cracks leading to the boat area
Boat north-east of the Zao Steppe
Shortcut between Zao and the Falcon Bastion island
You can only use this shortcut if you have completed {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.
In the underground area you first have to kill another miniboss, to the **north-west**: the {creature:Dazed Leaf Golem}.

Then step into the {wiki:Electric Sparks} to the **south**. In the **north-west** part of this room (which on the {wiki:Automap} is shaped like a falcon's head) there are some {wiki:Mystic Flame|Mystic Flames}, the falcon's eye. Step into them and you reach the lever room for the {creature:Grand Master Oberon} fight.
The fight is physical and verbal: you have to answer Oberon's insults three times with the right sentence from the castle documents.

When {creature:Grand Master Oberon} reaches red health, he summons a {creature:Falcon Knight} or a {creature:Falcon Paladin}, heals fully and keeps healing from all the damage you deal him. At the same time he starts arguing with you: an orange message appears until someone speaks in the {wiki:Local Chat Channel} or the {wiki:NPCs Channel}; then he goes quiet and becomes vulnerable again. Each time he reaches red he says a different sentence and you have to reply with the right argument. You need to get it right **3 times** during the fight to be able to kill him. If you get it right he growls (*GRRRAAANNGH!*); if you get it wrong he laughs at you (*HAHAHAHA!*).
All the answers are in the documents you find in the castle (each volume has one sentence). Type the answer in the **Local** chat or the **NPCs** channel as soon as Oberon says his line.

Since many players kill Oberon every day, it's worth having the answers on hotkeys or action buttons. The right answer is recognised even when mixed with others, so **2 buttons** are enough: one with the answers to the 3 sentences starting with **T** (I, VIII and IX) and another with the rest. You can't put everything on a single one, because it goes over a message's character limit.
Example of action buttons for the answers

The wiki doesn't describe the way out of Oberon's room: go back the way you came (Mystic Flames, Electric Sparks and the underground area) to the castle ground floor. If you have {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} and activated the shortcut, use the small boat south of the swimming area to go to the boat **north-east** of the {wiki:Zao Steppe}. From there head back to the mountain pass ({coord:33085,31532,7}), go up with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and continue **west** to the lift, which takes you to **Farmine**; there {npc:Thorgrin} takes you by {wiki:Steamship} to Kazordoon or Cormaya ({key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}).
Boat north-east of the Zao Steppe

Without {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} the wiki doesn't describe any other way out of the Falcon Bastion: in that case use a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} (it takes you to your temple; it doesn't work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block).
The Museum of Tibian Arts is being extended, but an aggressive portal has filled the building works with monsters. You have to break four seals in the Extension Site.
In **Thais**, west of the Knights Guild, go down one floor beneath the Games Hall and step into the teleport to the {wiki:Museum of Tibian Arts} (it only works with a Premium account).

Talk to {npc:Gareth}. If you aren't a museum patron yet, sort that out first ({key:patron} and {key:yes}; in the {wiki:Cults of Tibia Quest} this costs 10,000 gp). Then say {key:extension}, {key:problem} and {key:yes}: he opens the sealed door to the building works for you.

Go through the {item:Door (Sealed)|sealed door}. Behind it there is a {wiki:Fire Portal} leading to {wiki:The Extension Site}, home to {creature:Floating Savant|Floating Savants}, {creature:Retching Horror|Retching Horrors}, {creature:Fury|Furies} and {creature:Hellhound|Hellhounds}.
Go **west** and follow the corridor **north** to a large {item:Bone Lever} and a sealed door. Use the lever: nothing happens for now.
Go back to the museum entrance and ask {npc:Gareth} about the lever: {key:bone}.

Back in the Extension Site, go to the central room (guarded by 4 {creature:Hellhound|Hellhounds}). Kill the creatures first, then use the lever in this room and run back to the Bone Lever to use it as well: it should change position. You now have access to the sealed doors **south** of the Bone Levers, which lead to the floor below.
The Bone Lever takes a few seconds to return to its starting position. If several people in the team are doing the access, do this last step a few seconds apart so the lever is in the right position.
Go down the stairs, go around the water to the **north-east** and pick up the {item:Bony Rod}: you'll need it later.
There are also {creature:Demon|Demons} on this floor.

On this floor you have to mine the {item:Crystals (Energy)|blue crystals} scattered around the room with a {item:Pick} (or a Secret Service tool). You can get one of three balls: {item:Yellow Energy Ball}, {item:Green Energy Ball} or {item:Red Energy Ball}. You need one of each and you have to wait a few minutes between attempts.
The balls disappear about **1 minute** after being mined: focus on one colour at a time, close to its basin.
Put the balls in the Coal Basins
Use each Energy Ball on the matching empty {item:Coal Basin}. Once all three are right, you can move on to the next seal.
Map of the second seal with the three basins
Using the Energy Ball on the basin

If you try to go through the teleports without having put the three balls in the right basins, you are teleported back to the basin, which by then may be full of creatures. If you can't handle the spawn alone, split the team across the 3 basins and make sure everyone has got the access.

This seal has to be done quickly: make sure you understand the steps before you start. Fight your way to the far **west** part of the floor, where there is a chest. Use it to receive a {item:Ruby Fire Stone} and use it **straight away** on the {item:Bony Rod}, otherwise it disappears. You get a {item:Bony Rod (Ruby)}.

You have to carry the rod to an empty basin on the other side of the room, but it loses its charge unless you keep recharging it: use it on the {item:Coal Basin|Coal Basins} found all over the dungeon. The recommended approach is not to kill the monsters: run through the **south** corridor and recharge the rod at every basin you come across; {item:Energy Bomb Rune|Energy Bomb Runes} help you avoid most of the creatures. In the **east** part of the floor, use the charged rod on the empty basin so you can get through the door.
If the rod loses its charge you have to fetch another Ruby Fire Stone, and there is a **2-minute** wait counting from the last one you picked up.

The chest next to the door needs a {item:Sample of Monster Blood}, which you find on the first floor. Use the flask on the skull without blood next to the chest (the middle one, just **east** of the door) and then go through the {item:Door (Sealed)|sealed door} **south** of it to receive a {item:Broken Compass}. It is **not needed** for this quest.
The Broken Compass is used in {wiki:The Dream Courts Quest}.

When you enter the teleport after the third seal you are greeted by more than 10 {creature:Lava Golem|Lava Golems}. You have to **walk over the inscriptions** on the **north-west** side of the room and, after that, stay in the room for **3 minutes** before you can leave. You do not need to kill the Lava Golems, but it is safer, even though they spawn very quickly.
If you want to avoid the fight, stand on {item:Energy Bomb Rune|Energy Bombs}: the Lava Golems do not walk over them.

Once the 3 minutes are up, leave through the teleport to the **south-east**: you appear at the entrance of the Extension Site. Go back to the museum the way you came in and say {key:extension} to {npc:Gareth}. He translates the inscription and sends you to Dedoras.
Go back the same way to the museum's entrance teleport, which leaves you underneath the Games Hall, in Thais.
9. Back to Dedoras: Battle Mage and the library entrance

With the six parts done, go back to **Cormaya** (section 1) and talk to {npc:Dedoras}: {key:hi}, {key:search}, then the name of each previous mission ({key:museum}, {key:desert}, {key:fishmen}, {key:order}, {key:asuri} and {key:isle}) and finally {key:check}, so that he checks the information. You receive the **Battle Mage** achievement and the base {wiki:Battle Mage Outfits|Battle Mage Outfit}. He also explains how to get into the library.
The Battle Mage addons are also given by Dedoras: see the {wiki:Battle Mage Outfits Quest}.
10. The Secret Library and the four bosses
In the library you have to kill four bosses before the final challenge. Each boss room takes teams of **up to 5 players**, has a **17-minute** time limit and a 20 h cooldown.
Get to the Isle of the Kings

Go to **Carlin** and then to {npc:Dalbrect}'s hut and boat, at the harbour **north and west** of the city (north of the Ghostlands). Say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}: he takes you to the {wiki:Isle of the Kings} for 10 gp (only if you are already his friend, from having given him the {item:Family Brooch} in {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest}).
Dalbrect (boat to the Isle of the Kings)

In the {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest|White Raven} monastery, go into the main altar room. There are two monuments: use a {item:Scythe} on the **right-hand** {item:Monument} (Dedoras tells you to do it while thinking of the glyph and chanting *Chamek Athra Thull Zathroth*). You enter the {wiki:Secret Library}, beneath north-west Tiquanda.
Map of the Secret Library sections (1)
Map of the Secret Library sections (2)
You cannot use a {wiki:Secret Agent Tools|Secret Agent Tool} to get in: it has to be a normal Scythe.

The library has four sections, one per element (Fire, Energy, Ice and Earth), and some of the strongest creatures in Tibia, sometimes in large groups. Right at the entrance there are statues that fire a beam every few seconds.
Avoid the beam from the entrance statues: it deals more than **1000 holy damage**.

From the entrance, go to the **Energy Section** and keep heading **west**, before the hunting area, until you reach a teleport. Go in and, when the team is ready, pull the {item:Ostentatious Bookstand}. You have 17 minutes for the fight. Wear **energy** and **death** protection; attack with **earth** damage.

Start by attacking {creature:Lokathmor}. Shortly afterwards the team is sent to the centre of the room with the boss, now invulnerable, trapped by {creature:Force Field|Force Fields} (they look like {wiki:Magic Wall|Magic Walls}). The whole team attacks **the same** Force Field and destroys it as fast as possible to get out of the trap: inside it, Lokathmor causes **death damage** explosions that start at about 700 and rise quickly every turn.

After you get out, the explosion still reaches 1 square beyond the Force Fields: you are only safe **2 squares** or more away from them. The Force Fields do not block spells: the boss's explosions and your attacks go through them.
Lokathmor: Dark Knowledge and Writing Desk

A {creature:Dark Knowledge} appears in the **north** of the room. Kill it quickly, pick up the corpse (a {item:Parchment of Dark Knowledge}), use it on the {item:Writing Desk (Quest)|Writing Desk} on the **west** side of the room and then **use the desk**: the remaining Force Fields are destroyed and Lokathmor is free to be attacked for **20 seconds**. Then the trap starts again; repeat everything until the boss dies.

Timing is everything in this fight: losing one turn can mean failure. Pick a Force Field that is not near any {creature:Knowledge Raider}, because they can move onto that square and rebuild the trap. The usual approach is to destroy a Force Field **north** of the boss, get out and go **left**, next to the desk, while the knight stays near the book; that way the summons stay to the left of the trap. When you kill the Dark Knowledge, leave one player next to the desk and throw the corpse to an agreed spot (for example, underneath them) so they can use it right away.

The Force Fields reflect damage ({wiki:Damage Reflection}): avoid area attacks, especially Ultimate spells, which can kill whoever casts them. They take almost no death damage, so {item:Sudden Death Rune|Sudden Death Runes} are useless.
Inside the trap you take a lot of death damage: use {item:Might Ring|Might Rings} and, after the first few turns, even {item:Stone Skin Amulet|Stone Skin Amulets}.

Go to the **Earth Section** and go down the stairs at this point (**south** of the {creature:Biting Book|Biting Books}); then walk **north** to a teleport. Go in and pull the {item:Ostentatious Bookstand} when the team is ready. You have 17 minutes. Wear **energy** protection; attack with **earth** damage.

{creature:Mazzinor} comes with several {creature:Wild Knowledge|Wild Knowledges}; when you kill them they turn into a blue vortex. Every few turns Mazzinor becomes {creature:Supercharged Mazzinor}, invulnerable. **8 seconds** later the room is hit by several energy explosions at once, with different centres, which cover every square and deal up to **13,000+ energy damage** (the closer you are to the centre, the more explosions hit you). You avoid all of it if you step on a vortex and take the form of a {creature:Knowledge Elemental}, which also lasts 8 seconds.

Wait at least **2 seconds** after the boss transforms before stepping on the vortex, so that your form lasts until the explosions. You can only renew the form after it ends: if you transform too early, you are left exposed.

One possible strategy: the blocker keeps Mazzinor near the centre of the room and the shooters spread out around it. Everyone attacks with {item:Stone Shower Rune|Stone Shower Runes} to hit several Wild Knowledges and create lots of vortices. Each player picks a vortex as early as possible, stands next to it and tells the team, so that nobody steals someone else's vortex. When there are many vortices and/or no Wild Knowledges, take the chance to attack only Mazzinor with {item:Sudden Death Rune|Sudden Death Runes}. After you transform, keep using area attacks to clear the summons for the next round.

Do not walk back and forth too much: you can step on a vortex by accident and fail to renew the transformation in time (if that happens, try walking back and forth on top of a vortex). Do not kill Wild Knowledges on top of an existing vortex: kill them on free squares to create new vortices.
If you cannot reach a vortex, a {item:Shockwave Amulet} reduces the explosion damage to 3–5 thousand. It only has 5 charges: put it on just before the explosion.

Before entering the library, bring a {item:Depth Galea} or a {item:Helmet of the Deep}: it is very important against this boss. From the entrance go to the **Fire Section** and go down to the second floor. Go to the room in the **south-east**, where the teleport is. Go in and pull the {item:Ostentatious Bookstand} when the team is ready. You have 17 minutes. Wear **drown**, **death** and **earth** protection.
Ghulosh: the Deathgaze and the Concentrated Death

During the fight {creature:Ghulosh} turns into {creature:Ghulosh' Deathgaze}. The goal is to get rid of the Deathgaze, but players cannot hurt it. First destroy {creature:The Book of Death}, which appears in the **north** of the room, to release a {creature:Concentrated Death} (it is a good idea to leave the book at red health and only finish it off when needed). Then you have to line up the Deathgaze with the Concentrated Death: the Deathgaze's Death Beam deals a lot of **drown** damage to players, but when it hits the Concentrated Death it hurts the Deathgaze itself for 6000–8600, through {wiki:Damage Reflection|damage reflection}.
The Concentrated Death dies quickly to attacks from players and summons: do not damage it. If it dies, the book reappears shortly afterwards and you can kill it to get another one.

The Deathgaze attacks from a distance and cannot be fully trapped, otherwise it teleports to the centre of the room. To control it, the knight uses {spell:Challenge} and pushes it into one of the wall corners; then {item:Magic Wall Rune|Magic Walls} and {item:Wild Growth Rune|Wild Growths} stop it from moving sideways. Meanwhile another player brings the Concentrated Death and places it in front of the Deathgaze, as in the picture.
How to trap the Deathgaze with the Concentrated Death in front

The first two times the Deathgaze hits the Concentrated Death, the damage is enough for it to turn back into Ghulosh straight away. On the **third** time you have to make it hit itself several times until it returns to its normal form; then you can kill the boss. During the fight {creature:Bone Jaw|Bone Jaws} and {creature:Blood Tear|Blood Tears} appear: clear the Bone Jaws whenever you can so they do not pile up, but do not waste time or resources on the Blood Tears, which respawn as soon as they die.
When clearing the minions, do not hurt or kill the Concentrated Death.

From the entrance go to the **Fire Section**, keep heading **east** and then **south**, until you reach the teleport. Go in and pull the {item:Ostentatious Bookstand} when the team is ready. You have 17 minutes. Wear **fire** protection; use **ice** damage on the minions and the boss and **death** damage on the boss.

To kill {creature:Gorzindel} you first have to weaken him. Attack the {creature:Stolen Tome of Portals} in the **north** of the room (ignore the {creature:Malicious Minion|Malicious} and {creature:Mean Minion|Mean Minions} for now). When it dies, its corpse is a teleport: the whole team jumps in quickly. Each player ends up in a separate small room with a {creature:Malicious Minion} and another book, responsible for one of the boss's abilities. You have about **4 turns** to attack it before you return to the main room. Repeat until all 5 books are dead.

The boss paralyses a lot: get close to the Stolen Tome when it is almost dead. When you come back from the small rooms, several minions appear in the main room and hit quite hard if they combo: use {item:Avalanche Rune|Avalanche Runes} to clear the room, especially the Malicious Minions, which die faster.
With the 5 books dead, all that is left is to attack Gorzindel until he dies.
Shooters should stay by the **left** wall of the room to avoid the Stolen Tome's death spell around it.
After killing the four bosses, you can enter the final battle teleport. Unlike the others, this one takes teams of **up to 10 players**.

From the entrance go **south** and then keep heading **west**. Go down a few floors to a small room. Enter the teleport to reach the room with the {item:Ostentatious Bookstand} and pull it once the team is ready.
Small room with the final battle teleport
The central chamber and the first wave

You are teleported to a large room with the NPC {npc:Cerebrir} and {creature:Magic Discharge|Magic Discharges}. After **30 seconds** creatures start appearing in the **north** of the room: {creature:Rift Spawn|Rift Spawns}, {creature:Rift Minion|Rift Minions}, {creature:Imp Intruder|Imp Intruders}, {creature:Ravenous Beyondling|Ravenous Beyondlings} and {creature:Yalahari Despoiler|Yalahari Despoilers}. Kill them with area attacks.
Killing the first wave in the main room

At the same time, the masterbook on top of the Ostentatious Bookstand in the middle of the room charges up (*“THE MASTERBOOK HAS FILLED UP WITH THE WRATH OF THE LIBRARY!”*). If you click on it, it fires a drown damage beam to the **north** and recharges 30 seconds later. It damages the minions and the final boss, but keeping the boss north of it is not worth it, so the usual strategies ignore it.

One minute later *“THE NORTH EASTERN WING HAS BEEN BREACHED! RUSH TO CRUSH THE INTRUDERS!”* appears. Enter the **north-east** teleport: there you find {creature:The Spellstealer} and {creature:Demon Slave|Demon Slaves}. The boss is invulnerable in its {creature:The Spellstealer (Destructor)|Destructor} (red) and {creature:The Spellstealer (Creator)|Creator} (green) forms. To make it vulnerable, lure it to the vortex of its colour: if it is **green**, to the {wiki:Vortex of Creation Lore|green vortex} in the **north-west** (*“The creation vortex consumes the stolen energy!”*); if it is **red**, to the {wiki:Vortex of Destruction Lore|red vortex} in the **south-east** (*“The destruction vortex consumes the stolen energy!”*). At the right vortex it turns light grey and vulnerable. After a while it becomes invulnerable again (*“The spellstealer absorbs the power of destruction!”* or *“...of creation!”*) and you have to repeat this. After killing it, go back to the central chamber: a new wave starts, now also with {creature:Invading Demon|Invading Demons}.
South-east wing: The Scion of Havoc

One more minute killing the wave and the **south-east** wing opens (*“THE SOUTH EASTERN WING HAS BEEN BREACHED! RUSH TO CRUSH THE INTRUDERS!”*). Inside are {creature:The Scion of Havoc} and several {creature:Spawn of Havoc|Spawns of Havoc}. Trap the boss in a corner while one or two team members keep the Spawns of Havoc away from it. After killing it, go back to the central chamber for the next wave.
Killing The Scion of Havoc while the rest of the team blocks the Spawns of Havoc
**Do not kill** the Spawns of Havoc: when they die they explode, dealing more than 1000 damage to every player around them, and that damage **heals** the Scion of Havoc.
South-west wing: Brother Chill and Brother Freeze

One more minute and the **south-west** wing opens (*“THE SOUTH WESTERN WING HAS BEEN BREACHED! RUSH TO CRUSH THE INTRUDERS!”*). There you find {creature:Brother Chill}, {creature:Brother Freeze} and {creature:Biting Cold|Biting Colds}. The brothers and the Biting Colds heal each other, so you have to keep them apart: start with either brother while the rest of the team keeps the other one and the Colds away. After killing both, go back to the central chamber.
Killing Brother Freeze while the team blocks Brother Chill and the Biting Colds
North-west wing: The Devourer of Secrets

One more minute and the last wing opens, in the **north-west** (*“THE NORTH WESTERN WING HAS BEEN BREACHED! RUSH TO CRUSH THE INTRUDERS!”*). You face {creature:The Devourer of Secrets} with {creature:War Servant|War Servants} and 4 {creature:The Book of Secrets}. Kill only the boss and keep healing the books with {spell:Mass Healing} and {item:Ultimate Healing Rune|Ultimate Healing Runes}, because they take damage from the boss and the summons. After killing it, go back to the central chamber.
Killing The Devourer of Secrets while keeping the books alive
**Do not destroy** The Book of Secrets: they make the Devourer stronger.

After some more time killing the wave in the main room, *“The Leader of the invasion finally joins the battle! Beware, the scourge of oblivion enters the fray!”* appears. In the **central** chamber you face {creature:The Scourge of Oblivion}, which constantly switches between three phases (table). While the boss is invulnerable, the shooters clear the summons that keep appearing around them, because they hit quite hard.
Deal as much damage to it as possible.
Reflects a lot of the damage it takes: **stop attacking** at once.
Invulnerable. Charges up for a few seconds and fires 7-square death beams to the north, south, east and west: get out of those lines.
Shielded form, which reflects and increases damage
Invulnerable form casting the death beams

When you kill The Scourge of Oblivion you earn the **Library Liberator** achievement and the messages *“NOOOO! WE HAVE BEEN FOOLED! THE ATTACK WAS A RUSE!”*, *“AMIDST THE DISTRACTION THE KNOWLEDGE ABOUT THE GODBREAKER HAS BEEN STOLEN!”* and *“COME TO ME! WE HAVE TO TALK!”* appear in the centre of the room.

The wiki does not describe a dedicated exit from the boss rooms or the library: go back the way you came to the entrance, next to the monastery on the Isle of the Kings. If you cannot find the way out, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} takes you to your temple (it does not work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block). To get back to the mainland, go to the boat docked at the island and talk to {npc:Captain Jack}: say {key:hi} and {key:tibia}. According to the wiki, he only takes you back if {npc:Costello} has given you permission (see {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest}).

Do not go onto the 3rd floor of the monastery (the monks' restricted area): if you do, Captain Jack and Dalbrect will not take you until you pay the fine to {npc:Costello} ({key:absolution}; 10,000 gp above level 60).

Cooldowns: {creature:Grand Master Oberon}, {creature:Brokul}, {creature:Lokathmor}, {creature:Mazzinor}, {creature:Ghulosh}, {creature:Gorzindel} and {creature:The Scourge of Oblivion} — 20 hours each. {creature:Furious Scorpion} — 2 hours.

In the Falcon Bastion there are several {item:Brass-Shod Chest|Brass-Shod Chests} that can give, among other things, {item:Gold Ingot}, {item:Death Ring} and {item:Roasted Dragon Wings}. In the basement, the breakable wall at {coord:33375,31343,8} leads east to the NPC {npc:Crowned Tree}, who gives you the chance to face the {creature:Thawing Dragon Lord}.

After the quest, the {wiki:Falcon Bastion}, the {wiki:Deep Desert}, the {wiki:Ancient Ancestorial Grounds}, {wiki:The Extension Site}, the {wiki:Asura Palace} basement and the {wiki:Secret Library} are open as hunting places.
